summary.intent: Fix failing E2E tests in CI (batch-download and streaming-playback), investigate a stuck release-gate workflow, and optimize the CI pipeline to gate cargo jobs behind Rust change detection.
summary.outcome: PR #398 merged with E2E test fixes (beforeAll timeout, clickClear replacement, SW dev wrapper), CI cargo job optimization, and a proper todo logged for the root-cause SDK bug (uploadFile hardcodes GCM).

repo: Playwright's beforeAll hook has a 30s default timeout independent of test.setTimeout() — suites with slow wallet login need an explicit test.setTimeout() call at the top level AND inside beforeAll.
The Escape key does not reliably dismiss the selection bar after batch operations; clickClear() is the correct approach.
The release-please PR branch carries its own copy of release-gate.yml which can reference stale workflow names after renames — self-resolves on next rebase.
Vite 7 cannot inject Service-Worker-Allowed headers on transformed files via configureServer middleware; the workaround is a static public/ wrapper that importScripts the real SW.

The SDK's uploadFile() in packages/sdk-core/src/upload/index.ts hardcodes encryptAesGcm (line 88) and encryptionMode: 'GCM' (line 113) — the selectEncryptionMode() CTR selection logic in apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts is only reached via the duplicate-file re-encrypt path, never normal uploads.
E2E tests for environment-dependent features (CTR streaming badge) should use test.skip() with a bug reference rather than soft assertion catches — the latter masks real regressions.
The ci.yml desktop filter previously triggered cargo jobs for TypeScript desktop frontend changes; narrowing it to Rust paths prevents unnecessary cargo builds.

code.finding: encryptAesGcm is hardcoded for all uploads; encryptionMode is always set to 'GCM'. There is no mode selection based on file size or MIME type, so CTR streaming encryption never activates for new uploads.
selectEncryptionMode() exists but is only called in the duplicate-file re-encrypt path, not in the normal SDK upload path.
Updated to use public/decrypt-sw-dev.js wrapper in dev mode to work around Vite 7's inability to set Service-Worker-Allowed headers on transformed worker files.
The desktop filter path list was broadened beyond Rust sources; narrowing to src-tauri/**, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, and the workflow file itself prevents spurious cargo job runs on TS-only changes.
Multiple locations used keyboard Escape to dismiss selection bar; replaced with selectionBar.clickClear() which is reliable.
beforeAll hook timeout must match the suite-level test.setTimeout() value (180s), otherwise Playwright kills the hook after the default 30s before login completes.

workflow: Always run E2E tests against staging (BASE_URL override) before concluding a test is broken locally — local wallet login was non-functional due to unrelated environment issues.
When a test consistently fails with a missing UI element, use Playwright MCP + browser console capture to trace the full feature pipeline rather than immediately softening assertions.
Use the /gsd:add-todo skill to log deferred work rather than ad-hoc TODO files — structured todos get committed with proper frontmatter and area tagging.
When fixing a test failure, distinguish between 'test is wrong' and 'test correctly caught a bug' — the CTR badge test was correct; the bug was in the SDK upload pipeline.

friction: Vite 7 configureServer middleware silently fails to inject headers on transformed files — multiple approaches tried (plugin, global headers, writeHead monkey-patch) before discovering the public/ wrapper workaround.
Background task notifications arrived after the relevant investigation had already concluded, adding noise without value.
Local wallet login was broken (blank page, button not found) which blocked local test verification and required pivoting to staging runs mid-investigation.
CI logs were truncated, requiring multiple targeted extraction commands to find the actual test failure lines.
A stopgap TODO.md was created manually before the user pointed out the /gsd:add-todo skill should be used — required cleanup.
open_items: SDK uploadFile() hardcodes GCM encryption — packages/sdk-core/src/upload/index.ts needs encryptionMode param support, using encryptAesCtr for media files >256KB. Tracked in .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-29-sdk-uploadfile-hardcodes-gcm-wire-ctr-encryption-for-media-uploads.md.
Release-gate on the release-please PR branch has stale --workflow=e2e.yml reference (renamed to ci-e2e.yml in #396) — will self-resolve when release-please rebases after next merge to main.
Local wallet login is broken (blank page in Playwright) — unrelated to the E2E fixes but worth investigating separately.
